body.x: Reusable Livechat reply templates in Malay, English and Chinese. Use them as a starting point and personalise to the player.

rows: Terima kasih kerana menghubungi Pasukan Sokongan VIP [brand], di mana sokongan istimewa disediakan untuk ahli kami yang paling berprestij.
Thank you for reaching out to the VIP Support Team, where dedicated support is reserved for our most prestigious members.
感谢您联系 VIP 客服团队，这里为我们最尊贵的会员提供专属支持。
Jap ye boss, saya check account boss dulu.
One moment please, let me check your account first.
Terima kasih kerana menghubungi kami, boss. Semoga bernasib baik dan selamat bermain! 🍀
Thank you for reaching out, boss. Wishing you the best of luck and happy playing! 🍀
感谢您联系我们，老板。祝您好运，玩得开心！🍀
Semoga boss menang besar hari ni! Kalau perlukan apa-apa lagi, jangan segan untuk hubungi kami semula ya. 😊
Hope you have a big win today! Feel free to reach out again if you need anything. 😊
希望老板今天大赢！如有任何需要，随时联系我们。😊
Boleh tolong berikan username akaun boss? Saya nak semak untuk boss. 🙏
Could you please provide your account username? I'll look into it for you. 🙏
请问可以提供您的账号用户名吗？我帮您查看一下。🙏
Boleh tolong berikan UID akaun boss? Saya nak semak untuk boss. 🙏

请问可以提供您的账号UID吗？我帮您查看一下。🙏

x: Greeting: replace [brand] with the brand name.
Holding: send it right after you get the UID or username, so the player knows you are checking.
Always use the latest template from the Team Engagement File.
Do not change a template without your TL's approval.
If a template is missing or out of date, tell your ATL or TL.
On the Zyra BO, fill all three languages (EN-MY, ZH-MY, MS-MY).
